audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows contradicted their own whys in both layers. Row 1 read Malphite though whys[1] opens "It's still even"; row 2 read Malphite though whys[2] says your W-Q-Sap Magic trade "out-trades him cleanly"; rows 3 and 4 read Skill though whys[3] hands him the durability stage and whys[4] hands him level 6.
audit.why: Level 2-3 is the one window Maokai's magic damage beats a Malphite who has not bought armour yet — the content layer credits the entire win rate to it. From 4 onward his W steroid and armour line shut it off, and Unstoppable Force at 6 is a 130s Flash-engage he can use on you or your jungler.
audit.corrected: Row 1 -> Skill (rating unchanged), row 2 -> Maokai 7/10, row 3 -> Malphite 3/10, row 4 -> Malphite 3/10. Matched full+content pairs in one atomic group, matching packet.levelChart.
sources: content.late ("the 56% win rate comes from owning levels 2-3")

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage was framed as an 'Unstoppable Force cooldown window', including levels 1-5 when he has no ultimate, and the first-item row credited Heartsteel while the content layer says the lane is already lost to armour by then.
audit.why: The real clock is: your level 2-3 window, then his W (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) armour steroid and first armour item, then Unstoppable Force on 130/115/100s at 1000 range. His Q is a flat 8s and steals move speed for 3 seconds.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[0].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, phases[5].why, tldr, winCon, enemyWin and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions absent from both layers. (1) Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max Health and RECHARGES if he has not been hit for a few seconds — so poking him with saplings between trades is what makes your commit land on a bare health bar. (2) Ground Slam's damage scales with HIS Armor, so the page's repeated claim that 'his stacked armor does nothing' is half wrong — armour is offence for him as well as defence.
audit.why: Riot passive text: 'shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.' Riot E text: 'deals magic damage based on his Armor'. Both change how you sequence a trade and how you read his build.

notes:
MIRROR CONFLICT — the user should decide this one. The malphite__maokai audit wrote 'Bramble Smash grounds on a 7s cooldown — bait it before you commit Unstoppable Force' into that page as a decisive point-4 finding. Bramble Smash's grounding flag is a derived tooltip-parse flag; Riot's own description of the ability is only 'knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them' — no grounding. Per the brief's rule (trust the description over a contradicting flag) I have refused to assert grounding on all eight matchups in my slice, which means Malphite's page now tells him to play around a Maokai ability that may not do what it says. Either the flag is right and my eight pages are missing a real interaction, or the flag is wrong and his page is shipping a fabrication. It cannot be both.

Separately, Malphite's OWN Q and E both carry grounding flags in his kit, and those are equally unverified from his descriptions (Q: damage + move speed steal; E: damage + attack speed slow). I asserted neither.

The packet defect 'Maokai wins 56.82% but the chart gives Malphite 4/7 stages vs 1' survives these edits and is, I think, genuinely correct rather than a defect: content.late states outright that 'the 56% win rate comes from owning levels 2-3', not from holding later stages. A lane can be won on one decisive window and lost on the rest.

Brief data note: top-level games is 571 but packet.games is 220.
